title: A woodland sequence
hook: Follow the arrows through a small food web.

doesNotKnow: Food-web arrows point from a food source to its consumer.

misconception: A food-web arrow points from predator to prey.
objective: Read direct feeding links and energy-flow direction in a specified food web.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In this simplified food web, arrows point from food to eater. Which organism receives energy directly from Bird? The highlighted arrow points from Bird to Hawk. These arrows represent feeding links in this stipulated web; real food webs have additional species and links.
claims.source: Stipulated teaching model; arrow convention: OpenStax https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/46-1-ecology-of-ecosystems

claims.text: This web is a selected hypothetical model, not a complete or universally observed food web.
Recall: An arrow goes from Bird to Hawk in a food web. What does the arrow indicate? The arrow points from the food source toward the consumer.

recall.question: An arrow goes from Bird to Hawk in a food web. What does the arrow indicate?
recall.why: The arrow points from the food source toward the consumer.
